subject: New to GGIR and in need of kind assistance and valuable feedback

messages.author: ab1a1962efdcced4
messages.subject: New to GGIR and in need of kind assistance and valuable feedback
parts:
Hi there GGIR community. I am relatively new to GGIR and I have been (trolling) this groups' conversations, YouTube tutorials and package info. Below is the script that I am running:

g.shell.GGIR(#-------------------------------
             # General parameters:
             #-------------------------------
             mode= c(1,2,3,4,5),
             datadir= datadir,
             outputdir= outputdir,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 1 parameters:
             #-------------------------------
             # Key functions: reading file, auto-calibration, and extracting features
             windowsizes= c(10, 900, 3600), #If c(60, 900, 3600) then 60s epoch files with a 15 min non-wear detection resolution and 60 min non-wear evaluation window
             do.enmo= TRUE,
             acc.metric= "ENMO",
             do.anglez= TRUE,
             chunksize= 1,
             printsummary= TRUE,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 2 parameters:
             #-------------------------------
             strategy= 1,
             hrs.del.start= 0, hrs.del.end= 0,
             maxdur= 8, includedaycrit= 16,
             qwindow= c(0,24),
             mvpathreshold= c(201),
             bout.metric= 4,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 3:
             #-------------------------------
             # Key functions: Sleep detection
             timethreshold= c(5),
             anglethreshold= 5,
             ignorenonwear= TRUE,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 4:
             #-------------------------------
             # Key functions: Integrating sleep log (if available) with sleep detection
             # storing day and person specific summaries of sleep
             excludefirstlast= FALSE,
             includenightcrit= 4,
             def.noc.sleep= c(),
             outliers.only= FALSE,
             criterror= 4,
             relyonsleeplog= FALSE,
             do.visual= TRUE,
             nnights= 14,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 5 parameters:
             #-------------------------------
             threshold.lig= c(35), threshold.mod= c(201), threshold.vig= c(708),
             boutcriter= 0.8,      boutcriter.in= 0.9,     boutcriter.lig= 0.8,
             boutcriter.mvpa= 0.8, boutdur.in= c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig= c(1,10),
             boutdur.mvpa= c(1),
             includedaycrit.part5= 2/3,
             #-------------------------------
             # Report generation
             #-------------------------------
             # Key functions: Generating reports based on meta-data
             do.report= c(2,5),
             dofirstpage= TRUE,
             visualreport= TRUE,
             viewingwindow= 1)

My concerns:

1.) Is my script wrote correctly?
2.) Based on the generated pdf, attached (DSG3 and DSG16), it seems that DSG3's MVPA (in mg) returns no value and no Activity and Sleep report was generated for DSG16.

My issue:

Our subjects are issued with the wGT3X, worn on their wrist for ~8 consecutive days of continuous monitoring. As such, my supervisor is asking why does the Actigraph (ActiLife6 Software) reports that DSG3 and DSG16 (using Evenson Children 2008) returns 150 minutes and 36 minutes of MVPA respectively and that GGIR reports otherwise.

I would greatly appreciate your kind assistance in this issue that I am facing.

Regards,
Muhammad ALIF
Clinical Exercise Physiologist
KK Women's and Children's Hospital, Singapore

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] New to GGIR and in need of kind assistance and valuable feedback
parts:
1.) Is my script wrote correctly?
​

I cannot answer that question without a full understand of study design, sensor configuration and research question. I am happy to help you with that as a paid consultancy as it is difficult to answer based on a short email conversation. Also your other questions indicate to me that you could benefit from a GGIR training course. Please contact me directly if you are interested.

2.) Based on the generated pdf, attached (DSG3 and DSG16), it seems that DSG3's MVPA (in mg) returns no value and no Activity and Sleep report was generated for DSG16.
​

It is not clear to me what you mean by "returns no values". You only shared the pdf files, and in those files I see 0 minutes I MVPA? A zero is also a value.

It looks like DSG16 is hardly worn, so it is not surprising that GGIR may not be able to generate much of a report for that individual.

As such, my supervisor is asking why does the Actigraph (ActiLife6 Software) reports that DSG3 and DSG16 (using Evenson Children 2008) returns 150 minutes and 36 minutes of MVPA respectively and that GGIR reports otherwise.

Why do you expect two different software tools that process the data in a very different way to produce the same output?

Kind regards,

Vincent


Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
